description: Offline video material retrieval platform for semantic search, subtitle search, Agent API, and AI-assisted editing.

# VideoSeek [![License: AGPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL%203.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11-brightgreen)](https://www.lv17.top/) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/6v17/VideoSeek?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases) [中文说明](./README.zh.md) | **English** Search a local video library by **text or screenshot**, with **hard-subtitle OCR**; preview hits and export MP4, Jianying, or NLE timelines. By default, indexing stays on your machine (ONNX · Lance · FFmpeg) and **media is not uploaded**. If you turn on Cloud embedding in Settings, extracted frames and queries are sent to the cloud service you configure. > **Free forever.** Do not pay for resale or “paid install” copies — get it from [GitHub](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek) / [the site](https://www.lv17.top/). [Download](https://www.lv17.top/) · [Releases](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases) · [User guide (ZH)](https://ycnwd8tcjgtu.feishu.cn/docx/ZWkrdSqA6oJTOrxQ2XscxYtmnad) · QQ `1033551438`

--- ## Features - **Text & image search** — Natural language or a reference image to find similar shot time ranges - **Picture library** — Sync image folders, then search them from the Search page “Pictures” tab - **Hard-subtitle OCR** — Keyword search over on-screen dialogue - **Libraries & scope** — Multiple libraries, selected videos, search presets. Optional absolute time windows apply to every video - **Preview & export** — Timeline preview; MP4; Jianying draft / Premiere XML / DaVinci FCPXML - **Local-first** — Sync and search stay on this machine unless you turn on Cloud embedding, which sends frames and queries to the service you configure. On a LAN, a user machine can search the server’s indexed library by text or image; sync runs on this machine or the server. Localhost Agent API is separate > Optional: video understanding, tag search, multiple CLIP-family models, experimental recap cuts, and more. **Main path: sync → search → export.** ## Use cases | You have… | You want… | |-----------|-----------| | Large local or NAS libraries | Find shots by semantics, not filenames | | Dialogue or hard subs you remember | Jump to timestamps after OCR keyword search | | An editing workflow | Rough-locate clips, then open Jianying / PR / DaVinci | ## Quick start (installer) 1. Download from **[lv17.top](https://www.lv17.top/)** or [Releases](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases) 2. On first launch, **import runtime assets** when prompted (models, FFmpeg; OCR pack if you need subtitles) 3. Sidebar **Local Library** → add a folder → select videos → **Sync selected** 4. **Search** → query → preview → export ## Quick start (from source) **Windows 10/11** recommended. Other OS: see [`docs/quickstart.md`](docs/quickstart.md). ```bash pip install -r requirements.txt python main.py ``` ```bash conda env create -f environment.yml conda activate VideoSeek ``` | Missing | Action | |---------|--------| | Models / FFmpeg | In-app import, [123 cloud zip](https://1858268090.share.123pan.cn/123pan/VFA7vd-vhJXA), or [models release](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases/tag/models) | | VLC (Windows source only) | [vlc_lib release](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases/tag/vlc_lib) → extract at repo root | Fallback: if the model zip and `ffmpeg.exe` are already on disk, close VideoSeek, download [import_runtime_resources.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6v17/VideoSeek/master/scripts/import_runtime_resources.py), and run (no git checkout; writes `%LOCALAPPDATA%\VideoSeek`): ```bat python import_runtime_resources.py openai-clip.zip ffmpeg.exe ``` ## Documentation - [User guide (ZH)](https://ycnwd8tcjgtu.feishu.cn/docx/ZWkrdSqA6oJTOrxQ2XscxYtmnad) — illustrated installer walkthrough - [`docs/quickstart.md`](docs/quickstart.md) — from-source setup and troubleshooting - [`docs/for-agents.md`](docs/for-agents.md) — localhost Agent API - [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) — architecture (developers) - [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) — how to contribute ## Community - QQ group: **1033551438** - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/issues) — bugs, source builds, Agent API ## License [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) © 2026 [6v17](https://github.com/6v17) ## Support
detail.readme_zh:
# VideoSeek [![License: AGPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL%203.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11-brightgreen)](https://www.lv17.top/) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/6v17/VideoSeek?include_prereleases)](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases) **中文** | [English](./README.md) 本地视频语义检索：用**文字或截图**定位镜头，支持**硬字幕 OCR**，预览后导出 MP4 / 剪映 / NLE。 默认全程在本机索引（ONNX · Lance · FFmpeg），**不上传**素材。若你在设置里主动开启「云嵌入」，抽出的帧和查询会发到你配置的云服务。 > **永久免费。** 勿信收费倒卖或付费代装；请从 [GitHub](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek) / [官网](https://www.lv17.top/) 获取。 [官网下载](https://www.lv17.top/) · [Releases](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases) · [使用教程](https://ycnwd8tcjgtu.feishu.cn/docx/ZWkrdSqA6oJTOrxQ2XscxYtmnad) · QQ `1033551438`

--- ## 功能 - **文字与图片搜索** — 自然语言或参考图找相似镜头时间段 - **图库** — 同步图片文件夹后，在搜索页「找图」 - **硬字幕 OCR** — 按画面字幕关键词定位台词 - **库与范围** — 多库、指定视频、搜索预设；搜索页可填绝对时间段，套在每一条视频上 - **预览与导出** — 时间轴预览；MP4；剪映草稿 / Premiere XML / 达芬奇 FCPXML - **本地优先** — 默认同步和搜索都在本机。只有主动开启「云嵌入」时，抽帧和查询才会发到你配置的云服务。局域网里，用户机可以用文字或图片搜索服务机已经建好的库；同步在本机或服务机上做。另有 localhost Agent API > 可选：视频理解、标签搜索、多种 CLIP 系模型、实验性解说剪辑等。**主路径：同步 → 搜索 → 导出。** ## 适用场景 | 你的情况 | 你想… | |----------|--------| | 大量本地 / NAS 视频 | 按画面语义找片段，而不是翻文件名 | | 记得台词或硬字幕 | OCR 后按关键词跳到时间点 | | 剪辑工作流 | 粗定位后进剪映 / PR / 达芬奇 | ## 快速开始（安装包） 1. 从 **[lv17.top](https://www.lv17.top/)** 或 [Releases](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases) 下载 2. 首次启动按提示 **导入运行资源**（模型、FFmpeg；需要字幕时再导入 OCR） 3. 侧边栏 **视频库** → 添加文件夹 → 勾选视频 → **同步选中视频** 4. **搜索** → 输入查询 → 预览 → 导出 ## 快速开始（源码） 推荐 **Windows 10/11**。其它系统见 [`docs/quickstart.md`](docs/quickstart.md)。 ```bash pip install -r requirements.txt python main.py ``` ```bash conda env create -f environment.yml conda activate VideoSeek ``` | 缺什么 | 怎么办 | |--------|--------| | 模型 / FFmpeg | 应用内导入、[123 云盘](https://1858268090.share.123pan.cn/123pan/VFA7vd-vhJXA)，或 [models release](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases/tag/models) | | VLC（仅 Windows 源码） | [vlc_lib release](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/releases/tag/vlc_lib) → 解压到项目根目录 | 备选：模型 zip 与 `ffmpeg.exe` 已在磁盘、且不想点导入弹窗时，先关闭 VideoSeek，下载 [import_runtime_resources.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6v17/VideoSeek/master/scripts/import_runtime_resources.py) 后执行（无需克隆仓库，写入 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\VideoSeek`）： ```bat python import_runtime_resources.py openai-clip.zip ffmpeg.exe ``` ## 文档 - [使用教程（飞书）](https://ycnwd8tcjgtu.feishu.cn/docx/ZWkrdSqA6oJTOrxQ2XscxYtmnad) — 安装包图文上手 - [`docs/quickstart.md`](docs/quickstart.md) — 源码安装与排障 - [`docs/for-agents.md`](docs/for-agents.md) — localhost Agent API - [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md) — 架构（开发者） - [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) — 贡献说明 ## 交流 - QQ 群：**1033551438** - [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/6v17/VideoSeek/issues) — Bug、源码构建、Agent API ## 许可证 [AGPL-3.0](LICENSE) © 2026 [6v17](https://github.com/6v17) ## 支持
